summary: 3D physics mini-golf among the fairy chimneys of Cappadocia, redesigned as a fantasy miniature diorama with a wooden signpost UI, built by Claude Fable 5.1 · Kapadokya peribacaları arasında 3D fizikli mini golf, fantastik minyatür diorama ve ahşap tabela arayüzüyle yeniden tasarlandı, Claude Fable 5.1 yaptı
key_features: Twelve hand-designed holes, par 40: cave houses, a pottery wheel, a donkey crossing, a stone bridge and a sunrise ridge with balloons
Redesign: a moss and pebble diorama base around every hole, strata slabs, hero fairy chimneys, a warm peach haze and a numbered signpost at each tee
Redesign: wooden signpost boards with a cream face for every panel and the Fredoka font
Real rolling physics: slopes, ramps, wall bounces and moving obstacles; three challenge stars per hole and a ghost line of your best shot
Measured after the redesign: the bot finishes in 18 strokes with 23 stars and 0 JS errors, 60 fps and 25-27 draw calls
